notes: Token query list for the free X read tools (namespace 'x'). 'q' is the token clause only; the collector appends the shared exclusion suffix (counts) or the sample suffix (samples). Keep each full query under 512 chars. Ambiguous words are only used inside quotes or with a cashtag. Tiers: P = priority watchlist (every wake), W = browser watchlist / majors, C = top composite tokens. See COLLECTOR.md. Since 2026-10-18 the free X search strips '$', so cashtags are NOT used as the only clause for ambiguous tickers: use full names, contract addresses (the tool renders cashtags as chain:address) and AND-combinations with crypto words. Per-token 'quality' = clean | unreliable (unreliable rows are shown but excluded from the composite); 'regime.since' marks a query change (older data not comparable).
suffix_counts: -is:retweet lang:en -giveaway -giveaways -airdrop -"free mint" -whitelist -presale -"dm me" -"join now" -"claim now" -"claim your"
suffix_samples: -is:retweet -is:reply lang:en -giveaway -giveaways -airdrop -"free mint" -whitelist -presale -"dm me" -"join now" -"claim now" -"claim your"
